messages:
tasha: quick follow-up from this morning's RFC. we need a concrete plan for shared regional gateways: allocator behavior, carve-out criteria, and the controlplane contract we expose to connectors.

omar: brief take: default = shared regional gateway with explicit carve-outs for preserve-srcip and dedicated certs. avoid per-tenant gateways unless customer signs up for enterprise tier.

lucy: two practical requirements: 1) allocator must avoid hot-spotting IPs across tenants, 2) DNS split-horizon updates must be idempotent. propose allocator hands out labeled blocks (e.g., "slice-a:/28") and controller keeps a ledger with version stamps.

peter: also add an "egress_profile" in the control contract so connectors can declare preferences: {"egress_profile":"default|preserve-srcip|dedicated-cert"}. controller uses that to decide carve-out. older connectors default to "default".

tasha: agree. migration: new tenants -> shared slices by default. existing dedicated tenants get opt-in tooling. we should also provide an operator quick-path to carve a tenant out if they later need it.

omar: ops note: keep an emergency reserve pool (global reserve) to borrow from if slices exhaust. expose a metric ippool.utilization and alert at 65%.

lucy: DNS push idempotency: include per-tenant stamp and controller applies only diffs. avoids flapping and keeps change window small.

peter: security: when we centralize TLS on shared gateways, ensure tenant certs never appear in operator logs. for enterprise certs prefer SNI passthrough + dedicated certs carve-out.

tasha: action items:
- tasha: draft allocator playbook + reserve policy (due Fri)
- omar: add egress_profile enum to routing.contract.v1 (PR Tue)
- lucy: design ledger versioning + dns-stamp scheme (doc Wed)
- peter: spec SNI passthrough constraints and logging redaction (PR Mon)

ops-bot: routing-slice-controller canary deploy to staging started (build ci-5277) 1729812350

omar: will add compatibility note: connectors <v2 will be treated as "default" and receive SNAT mapping. we'll surface a header warning so SDKs can show migration hints.

lucy: testing: plan a scale test with 7k tenants across 3 slices, simulate churn and dns updates. we'll capture egress.ip_changes metric.

tasha: ok team, keep this thread for updates. i'll consolidate into the RFC follow-up and post the operator playbook draft when ready. :thumbsup:
